about: Retyped during the batch 1 review: these endings were proposed as part_of (links #28, #31, #36).

links.why: Lee's surrender at Appomattox effectively ended the war.
The Treaty of Paris formally ended the revolutionary war.
The Communist victory and the founding of the People's Republic ended the civil war's main fighting; no peace treaty was ever signed, and the Nationalists held on in Taiwan.
